name: impact-evidence-review-meeting
description: Prepares a one-hour review of your evaluation evidence, producing an agenda, a pre-read of one line per programme, a proposal per programme and a decisions table with owners and dates. Use for "run impact-evidence-review-meeting", "evidence review meeting", "review our training evaluations", "what do we do with the evaluation reports", "continue change stop or scale", "programme review agenda", "training portfolio review", "act on evaluation findings", part of the Claude Guide for Training Impact Pack by 90n.
